actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if [ "$(LC_ALL=C nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if LC_ALL=C bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes"; then echo true; else echo false; fi'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 0; else wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 1; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if LC_ALL=C wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ | grep -q "\[MUTED\]"; then echo false; else echo true; fi'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 0; else wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 1; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if LC_ALL=C wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ | grep -q "\[MUTED\]"; then echo false; else echo true; fi'
